caption: The drawing features a single creature rendered in shades of turquoise and light blue, centrally positioned on a plain, light beige background. The creature combines features of different animals and possibly mythological elements: it has the head of a lion (with an open mouth and visible teeth and tongue), the body and foreleg of a feline, and a single outstretched wing resembling a bird's, covered with detailed feathers. The inlaid textures on the body, feathers, and paw are rendered with fine lines and shading to suggest form and volume. Near the shoulder, the texture becomes more circular and plated, while a central spiral accent appears beside the joint. The drawing uses consistent coloration and intricate detailing throughout the composition.
title: Ornamental Iron Griffon
